Our delivery approach is a phased, parallelized rollout across all twelve hospitals to achieve rapid time-to-generation while maintaining consistent quality controls and documentation for each site. We have executed solar energy deployments on timelines ranging from 10 months to 33 months depending on scope and approvals, including a 10‑month solar deployment completed in 2024 (PKR 171M) that we use as an anchor for this program schedule. [CAP-032][CAP-008]

From Notice to Proceed (NTP), we propose an execution period of approximately 10 months through commissioning of all sites, followed by the required three (3) years of O&M. This plan also reflects our experience delivering for provincial and federal government clients in Pakistan. [CAP-008][CAP-020][CAP-042][CAP-018]

Planned phases and indicative durations (from NTP): (1) Mobilization & hospital-wise site surveys (Weeks 1–4); (2) Detailed engineering design, IFC drawings, and submission package preparation for each hospital (Weeks 3–10); (3) Procurement and logistics in parallel with design finalization (Weeks 6–16); (4) Civil/electrical installation in rolling waves across hospitals, enabling concurrent workstreams (Weeks 10–32); (5) Testing, grid synchronization, and commissioning per hospital with punch-list closure (Weeks 24–40); (6) Training and handover documentation per hospital, aligned to commissioning (Weeks 24–40); (7) O&M for 36 months from each site’s commissioning.

Our library does not yet evidence Tier‑1 module/inverter supply, SCADA-based central monitoring, or DISCO net‑metering liaison; we will address these mandatory items through nominated OEM/technology partners and dedicated permitting resources, with responsibilities and interfaces defined in the Project Execution Plan submitted at contract award. [CAP-032]

We will staff the program with a PMP-certified project leadership function as evidenced in prior deliveries, and will submit the proposed Project Manager’s PMP credential and experience record for compliance with M5. [CAP-005][CAP-027]
